summary: Ondas Inc. filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026 reporting its acquisitions of three Israeli businesses — CaribouLabs Ltd., Insignito Solutions Ltd., and Ottopia Technologies Ltd. — and a related resale prospectus supplement covering 7,822,077 shares, of which 7,821,445 were issued as acquisition consideration and 632 relate to the earlier World View Enterprises deal. Shares were issued under Regulation D and Regulation S exemptions; Snell & Wilmer provided the Nevada legality opinion. No price, premium, stake, advisor, or close date is disclosed. Watch for dilution from resale overhang and any further deal terms.
